## 🎯 Demo Request Summary
**What type of demo or example would you like to see?**

## 📊 Demo Category
**Select the type of demo/example:**
- [ ] **New Complete Demo** - Full end-to-end demonstration with notebook, SQL, and documentation
- [ ] **Code Example** - Focused code snippet or mini-tutorial
- [ ] **Integration Example** - How to integrate with specific tools/libraries
- [ ] **Use Case Extension** - Extension of existing demo for new scenario
- [ ] **Performance Optimization** - Example showing optimization techniques
- [ ] **Deployment Pattern** - Production deployment example

## 🎓 Complexity Level
**What complexity level should this target:**
- [ ] **Beginner** - New to IntegratedML (like Credit Risk demo)
- [ ] **Intermediate** - Some ML experience (like Fraud Detection demo)
- [ ] **Advanced** - Experienced practitioners (like Sales Forecasting demo)
- [ ] **Expert** - Complex integration scenarios (like DNA Similarity demo)
